text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah! Jordan's race is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!? The wait hath ended!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Our days off lined up AND we get to
cheer together?! Palmer, we are SO winning today! â

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally! All good in the... hood!
Let's shout from our bellies! Deep breath in...

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "J-Jordan... do your best...!"

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...W-Wait, Jordan hasn't even come out yet!
People are looking at us... This is embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
...Wait? Are those girls Jordan's besties?
Giving off first-time cheer vibes, totally?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, are you guys here to cheer for Jordan too?
Why not team up with us and bring the hype?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: "Wah!? Ah, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Only if you want to, of course.
Since we're cheering them on, wouldn't our voices reach them better if we're all in sync?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the academy, the racetrack is full of adults,
so cheering for the first time makes me nervous, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's put all our energy out there!
You guys want Jordan to win too, right?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
! Of course!
I just want you to win, Jordan!
I want you to do your best!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice, nice, keep that momentum going!
Pump up the volume, pump it up~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em, Jordan~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Uh-oh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Heh, haha. When did those guys become
buddies with Helios? They look like they're having a blast.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Jordan☆"?
Like... of course I'm gonna do my best, duh.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... I really can't let myself look pathetic here.
choice_data_list: By the way, how are your nails looking today?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No problem-o. Besides, you booked an appointment
with that doctor guy after the race, right?
On this day, we were also scheduled to report on the follow-up progress to the hospital that had taken care of us before.
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the best results in both.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Sup.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Well, just you watch.
